LanguageData.MM_MechaAutoCombatDesc: With a pilot and enough light, pursue enemies and stop to fire once a clear shot is available. Does not kite. Manual movement takes priority; a manual attack or Stop disables automatic combat.
LanguageData.MM_ColossusAutoCombatDesc: With a pilot and enough light, pursue enemies, choose firing positions and retreat from close attackers while firing on the move. Manual movement takes priority; a manual attack or Stop disables automatic combat.
